rule: A translation is judged only on whether it renders the whole Slovak sentence. An English passive is CORRECT when it keeps the agent (e.g. 'is repaired by my father'), or when the Slovak sentence itself names no agent. When the Slovak names an agent (a nominative subject doing the action, including a pronoun or 'niekto') and the English answer drops it, the learner left out half the translation: that is an omission and the answer is WRONG. Dropping any other content word is WRONG too; dropping only a function word or particle is CORRECT. For each item answer: verdict correct|wrong, dropped (Slovak = English, or empty), borderline true|false with a short reason.

items.slovak: Odkedy zaviedli nový systém, zamestnanci hlásia oveľa menej chýb.
items.answer: Since the new system was introduced, far fewer errors are reported by the employees.

items.slovak: Otec mi povedal, že on zamkol garáž ešte pred obedom.
items.answer: My father told me that the garage had been locked before lunch.

items.slovak: Ak zajtra neprestane pršať, tréner zruší celý zápas.
items.answer: If it doesn't stop raining tomorrow, the coach will cancel the whole match.

items.slovak: Keby si Lucia bola prečítala pokyny, nebola by pokazila celú tabuľku.
items.answer: If the instructions had been read by Lucia, the whole spreadsheet would not have been ruined.

items.slovak: Ja teraz čítam novú knihu o zvieratách.
items.answer: A new book about animals is being read now.

items.slovak: Marek každý večer zamyká bránu do záhrady.
items.answer: The garden gate is locked every evening.

items.slovak: Marek každý večer zamyká bránu do záhrady.
items.answer: The garden gate is locked by Marek every evening.

items.slovak: My zajtra uvaríme polievku pre celú rodinu.
items.answer: Soup will be cooked for the whole family tomorrow.

items.slovak: Kým my sme čakali na verdikt, právnik niekoľko dní pripravoval odvolanie.
items.answer: While we were waiting for the verdict, the lawyer was preparing the appeal for several days.

items.slovak: Prekladateľka, ktorú nám odporučili kolegovia, odovzdala hotový text o deň skôr.
items.answer: The finished text was delivered a day early.

items.slovak: Ona každé ráno varí čaj pre celú rodinu.
items.answer: Tea is made for the whole family every morning.

items.slovak: Napriek zlému počasiu organizátori nezrušili sobotný koncert.
items.answer: Despite the bad weather, the Saturday concert was not cancelled by the organisers.

items.slovak: Babka uvarila veľký hrniec polievky.
items.answer: A big pot of soup was cooked.

items.slovak: Zlodej minulú noc ukradol susedovi bicykel z dvora.
items.answer: The neighbour's bicycle was stolen from the yard by a thief last night.

items.slovak: Môj dedko pestuje paradajky v skleníku.
items.answer: Tomatoes are grown in the greenhouse.

items.slovak: Ja zajtra pošlem ten balík svojej sestre.
items.answer: The parcel will be sent to my sister tomorrow.

items.slovak: Ty musíš odovzdať to potvrdenie do konca týždňa.
items.answer: That certificate must be handed in by the end of the week.

items.slovak: Práve táto poisťovňa pokrýva aj škody spôsobené vetrom.
items.answer: This very insurance company covers wind damage too.

items.slovak: Ona napísala dlhý list svojej babke.
items.answer: A long letter was written by her to her grandmother.

items.slovak: Zahraniční kritici chvália tohtoročný program festivalu.
items.answer: This year's festival programme is being praised.

items.slovak: Vtedy sme si my ani neuvedomili, ako veľmi nám tá zmena pomohla.
items.answer: We did not even realise at the time how greatly that change had helped us.

items.slovak: Študenti minulý semester preštudovali tri hrubé knihy.
items.answer: Three thick books were studied last semester.

items.slovak: Kurátorka presunula najcennejšie obrazy do vedľajšej sály ešte pred otvorením.
items.answer: The most valuable paintings were moved to the next room before the opening.

items.slovak: Ona každý mesiac platí nájom za ten malý byt.
items.answer: The rent for that small flat is paid every month.

items.slovak: Marek každý večer zamyká bránu do záhrady.
items.answer: Marek locks the garden gate every evening.
